name: GTT Data Solutions Ltd (formerly Cinerad Communications Ltd)
tagline: A 1986-vintage TV-broadcasting/ad-films shell company renamed to 'GTT Data Solutions' in August 2024 and repositioned as an IT/data-analytics play - tiny (~Rs 16.5 Cr) and loss-making, with no evidence yet of the new narrative translating into a real business.
business_overview: Originally incorporated as Cinerad Communications Ltd in 1986 (television broadcasting, ad-film/documentary production, computer graphics/video editing), the company was renamed GTT Data Solutions Ltd in August 2024 and now describes itself as offering software development, IT integration and data-analytics consulting - a business-model pivot with no clear operational continuity from the original media business.
